review_evidence: README identifies the repository as the Extreme Value Distribution formalization project for an Aalto University formalized-mathematics course and links its blueprint.

The hydrated unit contains 17 Lean files and a proposition scan finds hundreds of theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations, establishing a substantial mathematical development rather than project scaffolding.
Course/project status and pedagogical provenance do not diminish the definitions, statements, proofs, and examples as formalization prior art; no lossless source-local exclusion was established.
summary: Retain the extreme-value-distribution course formalization and its full theorem/development surface.

review_evidence: ExtremeValueProject/AffineTransformation.lean: Defines AffineIncrEquiv (orientation-preserving affine isomorphisms of ℝ), their group structure, topology (metrizable, homeomorphic to ℝ²), and action on CDFs via (A • F)(x) = F(A⁻¹ x)

ExtremeValueProject/CumulativeDistributionFunction.lean: Core structure CumulativeDistributionFunction extending StieltjesFunction with tendsto_atTop=1, tendsto_atBot=0; equivalence with ProbabilityMeasure ℝ via equiv_probabilityMeasure
ExtremeValueProject/DegenerateCDF.lean: IsDegenerate predicate (values only 0 or 1), characterization as indicator of [x₀, ∞), equivalence with Dirac delta measures

ExtremeValueProject/OneParameterAffine.lean: Classification of measurable homomorphisms ℝ → AffineIncrEquiv into translation (index 0) and fixing-point (index ≠ 0) subgroups; solutions to Cauchy-Hamel functional equations

ExtremeValueProject/OrderContinuity.lean: Equivalence of order-theoretic left/right continuity with topological continuity for monotone functions on conditionally complete linear orders; lcMod/rcMod modifications
ExtremeValueProject/PseudoInverses.lean: lcInv/rcInv (quantile functions), double pseudoinverse equals lcMod/rcMod, continuity properties, composition with equivalences

ExtremeValueProject/SelfSimilarCDF.lean: Self-similarity characterization of EVDs: Gᵗ = A_t • G for measurable homomorphisms A_t; classification into Gumbel (index 0), Fréchet (index > 0), Weibull (index < 0) types

ExtremeValueProject/TypeOfCDF.lean: Convergence to types theorem: if F_n → G (nondegenerate) and A_n • F_n → G', then A_n coefficients are bounded; shrinking limits give degenerate CDFs, expanding limits impossible
ExtremeValueProject/WeakConvergenceCDF.lean: Lévy-Prokhorov metric on CDFs, equivalence of weak convergence with pointwise convergence at continuity points, Portmanteau lemmas
ExtremeValueProject/ExtremeValueDistribution.lean: IsExtremeValueDistr definition (nondegenerate + limit of maxima), standard Gumbel/Fréchet/Weibull CDFs

blueprint/ExtremeValueProjectBlueprint/Chapters/*.lean: 9 chapter files with informal mathematical definitions, lemmas, theorems, and proofs, each with explicit Lean cross-references (e.g., lean := "CumulativeDistributionFunction.IsExtremeValueDistr.affineTransform")
blueprint/ExtremeValueProjectBlueprint/TeXPrelude.lean: Shared LaTeX macros for mathematical notation (OriAffR, GumbelCDF, etc.)
lakefile.lean and blueprint/lakefile.lean: Lake build configuration for the Lean library and blueprint package
summary: Reviewed all 23 files in the RRU-5006d0e10abf work unit from the kkytola__ExtremeValueProject Lean formalization of extreme value theory (Fisher-Tippett-Gnedenko theorem). The unit contains 10 core Lean library files in ExtremeValueProject/ with definitions, lemmas, and theorems about cumulative distribution functions, affine transformations, one-parameter subgroups, pseudoinverses, weak convergence, and the classification of extreme value distributions into Gumbel/Fréchet/Weibull types. The 13 blueprint/ files are Verso Blueprint documentation mixing informal mathematical exposition with explicit Lean cross-references, documenting the same mathematical theory. Two lakefile.lean files are build configuration. All files contain formal mathematical content relevant to search.
